name: campusflow
description: CampusFlow — Intelligent Campus Management, Navigation and Student Services Platform

scripts.setup: composer install --working-dir=backend && npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix mobile install && php backend/artisan migrate --seed
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix frontend run typecheck && npm --prefix mobile run typecheck
scripts.check:static: npm run check:php && npm run check:api && npm run typecheck
scripts.check: npm run check:static && node -e "console.log('\n[gate] Static checks passed. These do NOT run the PHPUnit suite: a change can be syntactically valid and still be broken at runtime. Run `npm run check:full` before calling any work done.')"
scripts.check:full: npm run check:static && npm run check:test
